Savior.name: Savior
Savior.quoteHtml: Escaped from Tarkov for humanity: You placed your trust in Kerman - a step far beyond the mere instinct to survive. The strike against TerraGroup tore apart their mask: secrets were laid bare, corrupt politicians lost their power, and humanity cast off its chains and breathed free. People realized they could live differently, without descending into ruin. You escaped from Tarkov, but with you, the truth broke free as well. You did it for the sake of all of us.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.quoteHtml: Escaped from Tarkov but didn't escape from yourself: You nearly touched the truth, but you froze halfway, calling your fear caution. Kerman remembered you as unreliable. Everything you had uncovered dissolved into the swelling chaos. TerraGroup survived and grew stronger. Now you remain nothing more than a mercenary without honor, bound by a debt that weighs upon your heart. You broke out, but couldn't escape. You will never escape from yourself.

Survivor.name: Survivor
Survivor.quoteHtml: Escaped from Tarkov and survived: You ran, hoping to escape. It seemed like it would all end outside Tarkov—but hell erupted behind you. You didn't know you were part of the chain that destroyed the city. While the ashes were still warm, TerraGroup was reborn—and the world fell at its feet. You survived. But at what cost.

Fallen.name: Fallen
Fallen.quoteHtml: Escaped from Tarkov to fall in the darkness: You did not believe him — you hid behind fear and called it caution. Tarkov had fallen, and with it came madness; people lost their minds, the world began to crack apart. TerraGroup returned as a savior — but it was them who brought the ruin. You wanted to survive, but you fell. Into the Darkness, with no way back.

BTR Driver.name: BTR Driver
notesHtml: You can't hand in quests if you don't have enough inventory space for the rewards.
With a very low Scav karma level (-5), the BTR Driver disallows entry and no longer offers his services.
Reputation with the BTR Driver currently has no use, besides 0.4 being required to complete the Savior ending route.

Lightkeeper.name: Lightkeeper
notesHtml: You can't hand in quests if you don't have enough inventory space for the rewards.
The visit time in Lightkeeper's area is limited to 10 minutes per raid. Lightkeeper will break conversation after 9 minutes, and if you don't leave in the minute after, you will go MIA.
If Zryachiy dies while you are in Lightkeeper's area, Lightkeeper will break conversation trying to contact him and you will be sent out.
Reputation with Lightkeeper currently has no use.

prestige.introHtml: The Prestige system in Escape from Tarkov which only exists in the PvP game mode, allows players to start the game again from the beginning, only keeping their profile statistics, achievements, Arena ARP rating and armory progress as well as a percentage of character skills and weapon mastering. Some items can also be transferred, while the amount and allowed item types increase with each Prestige. Prestige levels and rewards persist throughout game profile resets and remain forever.

battlepass.introHtml:
To progress through this BattlePass, TerraGroup documentation needs to be found during raids. Unlocking each BattlePass reward requires turning in a specific type of documentation. This type of loot functions similarly to task items, meaning every player can pick it up, even if someone else has already done so. These items can be found while playing as either a PMC or a Scav in every game mode. Documentation comes in several different types, each tied to specific locations:
There are also Classified documents which can be bought in the Expansion Hub and used in place of any other documentation type. They are also valid for future BattlePasses.
It is also possible to exchange any 5 documentation for 1 documentation of choice.
battlepass.rewardsIntroHtml:
501 pieces of documentation are required in total to claim all the rewards, however the types of documentation required for each reward differ between players.
All but one reward from a page need to be claimed before it is possible to claim anything on the next page.

events.title: Shifting Balance
changesHtml: Glukhar has moved from Reserve to Lighthouse and appears in every raid in the water treatment plant. He always has 3 followers, one of each type.
Quest Fog of War has been added.
Quest Number Temporarily Unavailable has been added.
Quest All-Inclusive Support has been added.
Quest A Familiar Face... has been added.
Quest Scope the Clearing has been added.
Quest Lose the Tail has been added.
Quest Callsign Malachite has been added.
Quest Ease the Move has been added.
Quest Cut Down to the Root has been added.
Quest Preserve a Valuable Piece has been added.

events.title: Preliminary Survey
changesHtml: Quest Preliminary Survey has been added.

events.title: Permanent Boss Presence
events.quoteHtml:
Something big is clearly brewing in Tarkov, and the situation around the region has become increasingly unstable.
Scav Bosses armed themselves heavily and are now firmly entrenched in their territories. To prevent further escalation, trophies looted from them have been banned from the Flea Market. At the same time, rumors suggest that now might be the right time to start stockpiling that kind of gear.
On top of that, they say that night raids have become quite a lot riskier…
changesHtml: All Bosses, except for Cultists and Partisan, have a 100% spawn chance.
Unique weapons and gear from Bosses cannot be sold on the flea market.
Scavs and Bosses carry special weapon loadouts featuring high-capacity drum magazines.
New barters for Dogtags and unique weapons and gear from Bosses.
Glukhar carries a Magnum Research Desert Eagle L6 .50 AE pistol (WTS) loaded with .50 AE FMJ Bull.

events.title: Blackout
events.quoteHtml: Skier has discovered a vulnerability in the Lab’s security system and plans to strip the facility clean. Information this valuable was never going to stay secret for long, and now all kinds of interested parties are converging on the underground complex - each with their own motives. However, someone else was already one step ahead: a team of unidentified operatives in black had infiltrated the Lab. What they're searching for remains unknown, but their presence poses a serious threat.
changesHtml: The Lab has plunged into darkness and all lights are turned off.
Colored Lab keycards cannot be taken into a raid, except for the TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black).

TerraGroup Labs access keycard is available for purchase on Therapist LL2, LL3 and LL4, Ref LL3, and as a barter on Mechanic LL1 for 1× Weapon parts and at LL2 for 1× Bulbex cable cutter + 1× Pipe grip wrench.
Quest Wrench and Waterboarding has been added.
Quest Key to Every Door has been added.
Quest My Blood Type Mark is on the Sleeve has been added.
Quest Patch the Vulnerability has been added.
Quest If I Can't Have It has been added.
quests: My Blood Type Mark is on the Sleeve

events.title: Bonus EXP weekend
changesHtml: EXP earned from raids is increased by 25%.
This is a fixed value for all players and is applied instead of the edition bonus.
Owners of the "The Unheard" edition provide a 25% bonus to all members of their party.

events.title: Wild Wild Woods
events.quoteHtml: A Scav mutiny has occurred: splinter gangs have stopped following Fence's orders and are now shooting at anyone they encounter. Armed with revolvers and lever-action rifles, they have clearly looted some hidden stash. Rumor has it that the rebels are hauling their loot into the nature reserve, where a ton of valuables can now be found.
changesHtml: Quest Wild Wild Woods has been added.
New Barters for Silver Badges.
More and rare loot can be found on Woods.
Maximum number of PMCs reduced on Woods.
Shturman is in every raid on Woods and always carries a Silver Badge.
Scavs and Shturman carry Western-style weapons.
Cooldown between Scav raids is significantly reduced.
Player Scavs spawn earlier than usual.
No Scav karma penalty for killing Scavs as a player Scav.
New operational task for PMCs from Jaeger.
New operational tasks for Scavs from Fence.

events.title: Bonus EXP weekend
changesHtml: EXP earned from raids is increased by 25%.
This is a fixed value for all players and is applied instead of the edition bonus.
Owners of the "The Unheard" edition provide a 25% bonus to all members of their party.

events.title: Tarkov Hospitality
events.quoteHtml: Summer has arrived in Tarkov, and things are already heating up. Motivated by the success of the new Arena season, Ref is eager to secure new places to hold fights at. His men have been spotted on Shoreline, Customs, and even around the nature reserve. Jaeger refuses to stand by and watch this happen and is determined to fight back.
changesHtml: Ref's Cleanup Crew spawns in every raid on Customs, Shoreline, and Woods. They are neutral to PMCs.
Reshala, Sanitar, and Shturman spawn in every raid on their respective maps.
The Goons only spawn on Lighthouse in the PvP game mode, and not at all in the PvE game mode.
Quest Guardian of Nature has been added.

events.title: Bonus EXP weekend
changesHtml: EXP earned from raids is increased by 25%.
This is a fixed value for all players and is applied instead of the edition bonus.
Owners of the "The Unheard" edition provide a 25% bonus to all members of their party.

events.title: Icebreaker
events.quoteHtml: How did the Paradigm Shipping icebreaker end up trapped inside Tarkov’s blockade ring? What happened to its crew? Who is behind it all? You’ll uncover the answers by completing a new story chapter during an expedition focused on exploration and PvE gameplay. And if answers alone are not enough, the loot will make it worth your while.
changesHtml: Icebreaker location has been added.
Story chapter Boreas has been added.
Sanitar only spawns at the port/pier area and near the cottages on Shoreline.
Quest Stick to It has been added.

events.title: Full Speed Ahead
events.quoteHtml: Unusual Rogue activity has been detected along the coastline. Previously, they rarely left their camp at the water treatment plant, but now they appear to be conducting a full-scale reconnaissance operation. Peacekeeper is concerned about this development and wants to find out what they are searching for.
changesHtml: Rogues spawn on Shoreline, Reserve and in new locations on Lighthouse.
Glukhar spawns in every raid on Reserve.
The Goons spawn in every raid on Shoreline in the area from the gas station to the hydroelectric power station, and not at all on their other maps.
Quest No Smoke Without Fire has been added.
Quest Stealing the Stolen has been added.
Quest Alloy has been added.
Quest Mayday has been added.

events.title: Reshala vs Glukhar
events.quoteHtml: Reshala’s men stole supplies from the Reserve base, and Glukhar has no intention of letting it slide. His squad has arrived on Customs with a punitive raid, igniting a major gang conflict across the area. Regular Scavs are too afraid to get involved and are keeping out of sight until the situation calms down.
changesHtml: Reshala spawns in every raid on Customs.
Glukhar moved from Reserve to Customs and now spawns in every raid on Customs.
Reshala and Glukhar followers spawn all around the map, fighting each other.
Regular Scavs do not spawn on Customs at all, Player Scavs are limited to 3 in every Customs raid.

season.name: Season 1: KORD BREACH
differencesHtml: Special [KORD BREACH] questline is available starting with Prapor's quest Uninvited Guests - Part 1.
Hideout zones do not require items to be found in raid.
Black Division soldiers can be rarely encountered roaming on Ground Zero (Level 21+), Shoreline, Streets of Tarkov, and Woods.
Raiders on The Lab have been substituted with Black Division.
The crafting time of all Hideout crafts is reduced by half.
